signals.text: Revenue grew 59% a year over 3 years vs 50% over 5: growth is accelerating.
Profit compounded at 86% vs revenue at 59%: operating leverage is showing.
Operating margin compressed 42 bps in 3 years (4.3% → 3.8%).
Over 5 years, operating cash flow was 122% of reported profit: profits are turning into cash.

guidance.statement: Expect 20% to 25% volume growth quarter-on-quarter in mobile business for Q2.
guidance.quote: we expect 20% to 25% volume growth quarter-on-quarter growth as consumer demand strengthens and we have a strong order book.

guidance.statement: Expect telecom revenues to be between INR6,700 crores to INR7,000 crores in this fiscal.
guidance.quote: we're going to be somewhere between INR6,700 crores to INR7,000 crores in this fiscal.

guidance.statement: Expect smartphone volumes to hold near last year's level of 32 million to 33 million units.
guidance.quote: Our last year numbers were around 32 million, 33 million. We feel we should be somewhere close to that number.

guidance.statement: Expand camera module capacity in Q Tech from 70 million to 180 million-190 million annually over 15 to 18 months.
guidance.quote: expanding the capacities of camera module in subsidiary Q Tech... from 70 million annually to 180 million to 190 million annually over the next 15 to 18 months

guidance.statement: Vivo JV to commence operations and reflect in revenues from Q3.
guidance.quote: We expect the JV to commence operations and start reflecting in our revenues from Q3 of the current fiscal.

guidance.statement: New Noida facility for anchor customer to commence operations from Q3.
guidance.quote: Construction of our 1 million square feet facility in Noida... is almost completed. We expect the operations to commence from Q3 of this fiscal.

guidance.statement: Display facility trial to start from beginning of Q3 and mass production from end of Q3/beginning of Q4.
guidance.quote: trial will start from the beginning of Q3 and mass production to commence from end of Q3 and beginning of Q4 this fiscal year.

guidance.statement: Inventec JV IT hardware manufacturing facility expected to be operational from Q4.
guidance.quote: Our new manufacturing facility addition... for a 60-40 joint venture with Inventec Corporation... is expected to get operational from Q4 of this fiscal.

delivered.statement: Revenues for the quarter ended June 30, 2026, was INR15,557 crores.
EBITDA excluding fair value gain was INR472 crores and PAT was INR218 crores.
Completed around 7.5 million volumes for smartphones in the quarter.
Mobile and other EMS revenue was INR14,179 crores with operating profit of INR373 crores.
Home appliances revenue was INR382 crores with operating profit of INR32 crores.
Consumer electronics, LED TVs and refrigerators revenue was INR987 crores with operating profit of INR58 crores.

calls.tone: cautious on near-term margins due to input cost inflation and policy transition, but confident on long-term demand and growth.

pushback.gist: Analysts questioned the sharp increase in working capital and cash consumed during the quarter.
Pressed on whether domestic sales qualify for incentives and how the base year works.
Concerns raised regarding margin compression and whether margins will recover in the near term.
Questions on why Q Tech's margins remain subdued post-acquisition.

business.summary: Dixon Technologies is an electronic manufacturing services (EMS) provider manufacturing mobile phones, telecom equipment, IT hardware, home appliances, lighting, consumer electronics, and audio products for major global and domestic brands.

segments.name: Mobile and other EMS
segments.note: Includes mobile phones, feature phones, and EMS

segments.name: Telecom and networking products
segments.note: Includes 5G, FWA, broadband equipment, and radios

segments.name: IT hardware products
segments.note: Includes notebooks, desktops, AIOs, and tablets

segments.name: Home appliances
segments.note: Washing machines, refrigerators, and vacuum cleaners

segments.name: Lighting
segments.note: Indoor and outdoor lighting via Signify JV

segments.name: Consumer electronics
segments.note: LED TVs, refrigerators, and display products

guidance.statement: Expect a high-double-digit growth quarter-on-quarter in smartphones volume with selling prices up 12% to 15%.
guidance.quote: we expect a high-double-digit growth quarter-on-quarter in the smartphones volume along with growth in selling prices by 12% to 15%.

guidance.statement: IT hardware revenue is expected to cross INR4,000 crores in the current fiscal.
guidance.quote: we feel that our revenue in this fiscal is going to be more than INR4,000 crores.

guidance.statement: Telecom network revenue is targeted at INR7,500 crores to INR8,000 crores in FY27.
guidance.quote: We are targeting almost INR7,500 crores, INR8,000 crores in '26, '27.

guidance.statement: Lighting revenues are expected to grow almost 2x in the current fiscal.
guidance.quote: we expect the revenues to grow almost to 2x in the current fiscal.

guidance.statement: Camera module capacity is expanding from 70 million units to 180-190 million units annually.
guidance.quote: expanding the capacities of camera module and a subsidiary Q Tech... from 70 million units annually to around 180 million units to 190 million units annually over the next 15 to 18 months

guidance.statement: Camera module revenue target is INR2,500 crores in the current fiscal.
guidance.quote: We are targeting a revenue of almost INR2,500 crores in that business.

guidance.statement: Company targets overall revenue growth of 15% to 17% without Vivo numbers.
guidance.quote: We feel that without the Vivo also, the company will keep growing at almost 15% to 17%.

delivered.statement: Q4 FY26 revenues were INR10,520 crores and FY26 revenues reached INR48,893 crores, up 26%.
Q4 FY26 EBITDA was INR418 crores and PAT was INR192 crores (excluding exceptional items).
FY26 mobile and other EMS revenue was INR9,485 crores with operating profit of INR337 crores.
FY26 home appliances revenue was INR329 crores with operating profit of INR31 crores.
FY26 consumer electronics revenue was INR697 crores with operating profit of INR40 crores.
Working capital cycle improved to negative 8 days and ROCE stood at 44.8%.

calls.tone: Cautious on near-term demand headwinds and memory inflation, but confident on long-term growth and backward integration.

pushback.gist: Analysts repeatedly questioned the status and timeline of the pending Vivo joint venture approval.
Concerned whether flat volume guidance indicates market share loss or weaker industry demand below $200.
Asked about margin hits once the mobile PLI scheme ends and how much offset will come from backward integration.
Raised concerns about excessive reliance on the mobile phone segment affecting overall stability.

guidance.statement: Target to expand smartphone camera modules from 40 million units to 190 million to 200 million units per annum.
guidance.quote: target to expand volumes of smartphone camera modules from 40 million units in this fiscal to 190 million to 200 million units per annum.

guidance.statement: IT hardware revenue for next year is expected to be around INR3,500 crores to INR4,000 crores.
guidance.quote: We feel that for next year, the numbers are going to be somewhere around INR3,500 crores to INR4,000 crores.

guidance.statement: Total capex outgo for the overall fiscal is expected to be between INR1,100 crores and INR1,200 crores.
guidance.quote: And we feel that in the overall fiscal, it should be somewhere between INR1,100 crores, INR1,200 crores.

guidance.statement: Mobile phone business margin is expected to remain between 2.8% and 3.2%.
guidance.quote: We still feel that we should be able to have a margin of somewhere between 2.8% to 3.1%, 3.2% in our mobile phone business.

guidance.statement: Longcheer JV capacity for mobile phones is expected to be around 8 million to 10 million units in FY27.
guidance.quote: We feel that in '27 -- '26-'27, it will be around 8 million to 10 million units.

delivered.statement: Consolidated operating revenues for the quarter ended December 31, 2025 was INR10,678 crores.
Consolidated operating EBITDA for the quarter was INR421 crores and operating PAT was INR214 crores.
Smartphone volumes for Q3 were approximately 6.9 million units, bringing 9-month volumes closer to 27 million units.
Consumer electronics revenue for the quarter was INR567 crores with an operating profit of INR24 crores.
Home appliances revenue for the quarter was INR355 crores with an operating profit of INR41 crores.
Working capital cycle remained at negative 7 days with a net debt position of INR246 crores.

calls.tone: Cautious on near-term memory cost headwinds and post-festive demand, but confident on long-term scale and component integration.

pushback.gist: Analysts questioned the impact of soaring global memory prices and supply constraints on smartphone demand and margins.
Multiple analysts pressed management on the reasons for the prolonged delay in receiving PN3 approval for the Vivo JV.
Analysts inquired about the potential margin impact if the mobile PLI scheme is not renewed.

guidance.statement: Smartphone volumes next year targeted at 55 to 60 million units.
guidance.quote: So, next year, we feel that we should be somewhere between 55 to 60 million.

guidance.statement: IT hardware business targeted to reach Rs. 4,000 crores to Rs. 5,000 crores in two years.
guidance.quote: We feel that the IT business for us in next two years should be around Rs. 4,000 crores to Rs. 5,000 crores business.

guidance.statement: Capex run rate for the next 6 months to be broadly around Rs. 550 crores.
guidance.quote: Broadly, that should be the going run rate for the next 6 months as well.

guidance.statement: Targeting sales of around Rs. 1 lakh crore in next three to four years.
guidance.quote: you will be targeting around 1 lakh crore of sales in next three to four years.

guidance.statement: Operating margins expected in the range of 4% to 4.5% up to 1 lakh crore sales level.
guidance.quote: the range can be somewhere around 4%, 4.5%.

guidance.statement: Longcheer JV volumes expected around 8 to 10 million next fiscal.
guidance.quote: We feel that the volumes in this JV for the next fiscal should be somewhere around 8 to 10 million

guidance.statement: Smartphone camera modules revenue expected to reach Rs. 6,000 crores to Rs. 7,000 crores in 2-3 years.
guidance.quote: revenues closer to INR 6,000 crores to INR 7,000 crores and sub-10% EBITDA margins in the next two to three years.

delivered.statement: Consolidated adjusted revenues for Q2 FY26 grew 29% year-on-year to INR 14,858 crores.
Consolidated adjusted EBITDA grew 34% year-on-year to INR 564 crores in Q2 FY26.
Consolidated adjusted PAT grew 27% year-on-year to INR 323 crores in Q2 FY26.
Mobile and EMS revenue grew 41% year-on-year to INR 13,361 crores.
Telecom segment revenue grew 148% year-on-year to INR 1,635 crores.
IT hardware revenue grew 481% year-on-year to INR 331 crores.

calls.tone: Optimistic on medium to long-term demand and backward integration, despite short-term GST rate cut volume disruptions.

pushback.gist: Analysts questioned whether smartphone volume targets were scaled down from previous expectations and how much growth includes Longcheer JV.
Analysts inquired about the realization status and size of large outstanding PLI receivables from the government.
An analyst pressed on continuous promoter stake dilution over recent quarters and whether further selling is expected.
Questions raised on the profitability and duty disadvantages in IT hardware given India is a signatory to ITA-1.

guidance.statement: The lighting JV with Signify is expected to deliver revenue growth of almost 2x.
guidance.quote: our JV with Signify is expected to deliver revenue growth of almost 2x

guidance.statement: Construction of our new Noida facility is on track for completion by Q2 2026-27.
guidance.quote: Construction of our new one-Million-square-foot facility in Noida is on track for completion by Q2 2026-27

guidance.statement: Mass production at the Noida facility is set to commence in Q2 2026-27.
guidance.quote: mass production set to commence in Q2 2026-27.

guidance.statement: The Longcheer JV facility is expected to become operational by Q3 2026-27.
guidance.quote: The Longcheer JV facility, spanning 4,00,000 sq. ft., is expected to become operational by Q3 2026-27

guidance.statement: Dixon will be shifting to the ODM model by Q2 2026-27 and introducing sound bar TVs.
guidance.quote: We will be shifting to the ODM model by Q2 2026-27 and introducing sound bar TVs

guidance.statement: The new Tirupati facility for front-load washing machines is expected to be operational by Q2 2026-27.
guidance.quote: our new Tirupati facility for front-load washing machines, with an annual capacity of 3,00,000 units, is expected to be operational by Q2 2026-27.

guidance.statement: Mass production for the Inventec IT hardware JV facility is planned for the fourth quarter in 2026-27.
guidance.quote: mass production planned for the fourth quarter in 2026-27.

guidance.statement: Camera module Q Tech joint venture is expanding from 70 Million to 180-190 Million units annually over the next 15-18 months.
guidance.quote: expanding our Q Tech joint venture from 70 Million units to 180-190 Million units annually over the next 15-18 months

delivered.statement: Consolidated revenue grew 26% year-on-year to ₹48,893 Crores in 2025-26.
EBITDA excluding exceptional gain grew 23% to ₹1,887 Crores in 2025-26.
Working capital cycle was negative 8 days for 2025-26.
Overall gender diversity increased to 27% for 2025-26.
Delivered healthy ROCE and ROE of 44.8% and 28.1% respectively.
Deployed over ₹1,058 Crores in capital expenditure during the year.

calls.tone: Optimistic and confident, emphasizing strategic depth, backward integration, and disciplined execution amid transient headwinds.
